description: This Java source file defines the class ProductStoreCartAwareEvents, which provides static methods for managing store-related context within shopping cart sessions in the OFBiz framework. Key functionalities include setting the store in the session, validating store and website constraints, and updating session attributes accordingly.

classes.name: ProductStoreCartAwareEvents
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for handling product store session management and validation within shopping cart workflows.

methods.name: setSessionProductStore
methods.description: Handles HTTP request to set a product store in session, manages error cases, and returns navigation outcome.

methods.name: setSessionProductStore
